# Model server tools

The `pbi-model` server reads and edits the **semantic model** (TMDL) of a Power BI Project: measures, columns, relationships, calculation groups and DAX lineage. Edits are surgical text changes, so partitions, annotations and M source survive byte for byte. Call `pbi_set_project(path)` first.

**19 tools** (7 read-only, 12 write).

## How to read this page

- **Read-only** tools never change the project. **Write** tools do.
- **Destructive** marks tools that delete or overwrite content, so hosts can
  ask before running them. **Idempotent** means repeating the call with the
  same arguments changes nothing further.
- Write tools that edit project files accept `dry_run=true`: the operation
  runs on a scratch copy and returns the unified diff, and nothing is
  written. Every real write is journaled and can be reverted with
  `pbi_undo`. Do not use `dry_run` with the restore tools that take a path
  into the project. See [Safety](../safety.md#dry-run).
- Types are JSON Schema types. A parameter is **required** when it has no
  default.

## Project and diagnostics

### `pbi_doctor`

**Read-only** · idempotent

Diagnose the environment and the selected project (read-only,
never raises). Reports Python, mcp SDK and pbi-mcp versions; whether
the project is PBIR + TMDL (editable) or legacy report.json /
model.bim; declared $schema versions vs the vendored ones; table,
measure, page and visual counts; backup, undo-journal and trash
sizes; and (Windows) the installed Power BI Desktop version and
whether a Desktop instance is running. Works before `pbi_set_project`
for the environment checks. Returns {ok, findings[{severity, check,
message, fix?}], environment, project}; ok is false only if a finding
has severity 'error'.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_set_project`

**Read-only** · idempotent

Point the model server at a Power BI Project (.pbip). Call this first.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |

## Reading the model

### `pbi_get_model`

**Read-only**

Return tables, columns, measures, and relationships for the project.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_list_measures`

**Read-only**

List measures with DAX and format; optionally filter to one table.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table` | string | no | `null` |

### `pbi_model_lineage`

**Read-only**

Dependency graph (who references whom). Pass a measure for its deps + dependents.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `measure` | string | no | `null` |

## Measures

### `pbi_bulk_create_measures`

**Write**

Create many measures at once. measures: [{"table","name","dax",
"format"?,"display_folder"?}, ...]. The whole batch is validated before
any write happens.

Set dry_run=true to preview: the operation runs against a scratch copy and the response carries the unified diff; nothing is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `measures` | array of object | yes |  |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |

### `pbi_create_measure`

**Write**

Create a measure in `table`. Fails if the measure name already exists.

Set dry_run=true to preview: the operation runs against a scratch copy and the response carries the unified diff; nothing is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `dax` | string | yes |  |
| `format` | string | no | `null` |
| `display_folder` | string | no | `null` |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |

### `pbi_delete_measure`

**Write** · destructive

Delete a measure. Refuses if other measures OR the report depend on it
unless force=true. dry_run=true previews without writing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `force` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |

### `pbi_update_measure`

**Write** · idempotent

Update an existing measure's DAX/format/folder. Omitted fields are kept.

Set dry_run=true to preview: the operation runs against a scratch copy and the response carries the unified diff; nothing is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `dax` | string | no | `null` |
| `format` | string | no | `null` |
| `display_folder` | string | no | `null` |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |

## Columns, relationships and calculation groups

### `pbi_create_calc_group`

**Write**

Create a calculation group table. items: [{"name","dax"}, ...] using
SELECTEDMEASURE() patterns; order becomes the display order.

Set dry_run=true to preview: the operation runs against a scratch copy and the response carries the unified diff; nothing is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `precedence` | integer | yes |  |
| `items` | array of object | yes |  |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |

### `pbi_create_column`

**Write**

Create a column in `table`. Pass dax for a calculated column;
otherwise source_column defaults to the column name.

Set dry_run=true to preview: the operation runs against a scratch copy and the response carries the unified diff; nothing is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `data_type` | string | yes |  |
| `summarize_by` | string | no | `null` |
| `source_column` | string | no | `null` |
| `dax` | string | no | `null` |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |

### `pbi_create_relationship`

**Write**

Create a relationship (many-to-one from -> to by default).
Both endpoint columns must already exist.

Set dry_run=true to preview: the operation runs against a scratch copy and the response carries the unified diff; nothing is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from_table` | string | yes |  |
| `from_column` | string | yes |  |
| `to_table` | string | yes |  |
| `to_column` | string | yes |  |

## Undo, transactions and backups

### `pbi_begin_transaction`

**Write**

Mark a point so several writes can be reverted together with
`pbi_rollback`, or kept with `pbi_commit`. One open transaction at a time.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_commit`

**Write**

Close the open transaction, keeping every write made since
`pbi_begin_transaction`.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_list_backups`

**Read-only**

List every .bak-* snapshot the server has written, newest first.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_restore_backup`

**Write** · destructive

Restore a backup file (path from `pbi_list_backups`) over its original.

Set dry_run=true to preview: the operation runs against a scratch copy and the response carries the unified diff; nothing is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backup` | string | yes |  |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` |

### `pbi_rollback`

**Write** · destructive

Revert every write made since `pbi_begin_transaction` and close the
transaction.

_No parameters._

### `pbi_undo`

**Write** · destructive

Revert the latest `steps` journaled writes (newest first), restoring
every changed file byte-for-byte and deleting files those writes
added. Not journaled itself, so it cannot be undone.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | integer | no | `1` |

### `pbi_undo_history`

**Read-only** · idempotent

Journaled writes for the selected project, newest first: id, tool,
time and the files it added/modified/deleted. Both servers share the
history; any entry can be reverted with `pbi_undo`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | `20` |
